note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We hold $4.2 million in cash and burn $350,000 a month. We need to know how long our cash lasts.

answers.common.decision: Whether to draw the credit facility or cut spending; the CFO decides.
answers.common.deadline: The board meets in three weeks.
answers.common.materials: Our bank covenant requires a minimum cash balance of $700,000. Our revolving credit facility of $1.4 million is undrawn.
answers.finance-modeling.purpose: Measure the cash runway and the effect of the covenant and the facility.
answers.finance-modeling.data: Month-end bank balances and the monthly cash flow forecast, in US dollars.
